scope: Verification of approved Troops, Pets and hidden-hero simplifications only; no combat mechanics, layout, secrets or configuration changes.

baseline.sourceVerification: Baseline profile, bear-comparison, joint-plan, calculator and pet-effects files were byte-equal to this commit.
baseline.note: Shared failed names alone do not establish a calculation defect; individual errors and fixtures were reviewed.

selectedOriginalAssertionsWithRepairedFi.changes: Only the emptyProfile import was replaced with the existing entered-roster helper, in a temporary baseline test directory. Original numeric gear assertions and baseline production source were unchanged.

introducedRegressionsFixed: Raw-profile normalization broke existing calculation reuse; stable wrapper and normalized reuse context restored.
Legacy relative-upgrade helper defaulted to missing deployed counts; normalized 10/10/80 default restored.
modelBoundaries: Unknown progression, troop mechanics or bonus contributions remain unknown and can withhold the affected comparison. No formulas or expectations were weakened to value them at zero; absolute forecasts remain outside product scope.

requiredConfirmations.recommendationsWithoutCapacity: inventory-planning, calculator, bear-plan-defaults, dashboard-plan and joint-plan tests cover null/invalid legacy capacities, fixed 10/10/80, zero/unknown/surplus inventory and inactive march-slot gates.
requiredConfirmations.petTotalsOnceAndActivesSeparate: pet-combined-stats and pet-buff-assumption assert exact combined totals, separate scoped active abilities, documented upgrade deltas, level-zero and advancement behavior.
requiredConfirmations.enteredHostsAndLeadersOnly: fresh-roster covers all six hidden heroes even when saved as owned, empty/partial rosters, entered hosts and leaders, and no invented leaders.
requiredConfirmations.optionalFillersAreSuggestions: fresh-roster asserts owned:false, optional copy, no offense/capacity contribution and unique identities for suggested fillers.
requiredConfirmations.reloadPreservation: inventory-planning, pet-combined-stats, fresh-roster and legacy-capacity compatibility tests cover saved input/provenance retention and inactive legacy values after reload.

rankingImpact: For the preserved 10/10/80 snapshot, host Zoe/Petra/Yang and joining leaders Chenko/Amane/Vivian stayed unchanged when deployment size was removed. Exact fixed-formation count scaling cancels from relative comparisons. Old custom formations and capacity/level filler preferences can change outcomes by the approved simplification, not a combat-mechanics edit.

suite.note: The same test-file pattern as npm test, with the concurrency flag placed before files to enforce serial execution. Localhost access was permitted only for mocked HTTP tests.
suite.testCountChange: The eleven joint-plan cases now report individual results instead of a single whole-file failure: 340 cases rather than 330 in the previous failing run.
